name: Nikhil Chopra
title: Professor; Director of Undergraduate Studies
department: Mechanical Engineering; affiliate Electrical and Computer Engineering
fitReason: Combines control theory with machine learning and real manipulation. A newly published perception-and-force-controlled disassembly study offers a concrete physical-AI project direction; broad nonlinear/robot control expertise complements the learning component.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 14, 2026 Robotics and Autonomous Systems pre-proof integrates fine-tuned YOLOv8 detection, RGB-D localization, local alignment recovery and force-guided screw engagement. Publisher abstract/snippets report a 7-DOF Franka Emika arm with custom electric screwdriver, eight fastener types, three lighting conditions and 80 physical trials; aggregate end-to-end success is 82.5%. Bits were manually changed between trials. This is an integrated learned-perception/control system, not a reinforcement-learned manipulation policy. Co-first author Hemant Kumar is identified as Chopra's ME advisee in UMD's 2025 Future Faculty cohort; his public current page identifies him as a fourth-year PhD student. Current official SAS lab page describes actual underwater, ground, manipulator, aerial and soft-robot work.

shortVisit.summary: No current public external-master's short-visit invitation was found on the official faculty or linked SAS lab pages. General UMD institutional eligibility is documented separately and does not establish individual acceptance.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong physical ML/control integration; current verified learning is perception rather than end-to-end learned control.
scoreReasons.physical: Named real Franka protocol and current advisee link are documented, but technical evidence is limited to indexed publisher excerpts rather than a fully inspected manuscript.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current explicit external short-visit invitation; institutional route alone earns no points.
scoreReasons.freshness: Explicit September 2026 publisher date plus current institutional profile; one point withheld for indexed-only technical source and inconsistent author bibliography labels.
